mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM bangumi_collection
AND subject_type = #{subjectType}
AND collection_type = #{collectionType}
AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR user_comment LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY user_rate DESC, score DESC, id DESC
ORDER BY score DESC, CASE WHEN rank_num = 0 THEN 999999 ELSE rank_num END ASC, id DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rank_num = 0 THEN 999999 ELSE rank_num END ASC, score DESC
ORDER BY air_date DESC, id DESC
ORDER BY collection_updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bangumi_collection ( subject_id, subject_type, subject_type_name, name, name_cn, cover_url, score, rank_num, eps, collection_type, collection_type_name, user_rate, user_comment, air_date, tags, short_summary, collection_updated_at ) VALUES ( #{subjectId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectTypeName}, #{name}, #{nameCn}, #{coverUrl}, #{score}, #{rankNum}, #{eps}, #{collectionType}, #{collectionTypeName}, #{userRate}, #{userComment}, #{airDate}, #{tags}, #{shortSummary}, #{collectionUpdatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subject_type = VALUES(subject_type), subject_type_name = VALUES(subject_type_name), name = VALUES(name), name_cn = VALUES(name_cn), cover_url = VALUES(cover_url), score = VALUES(score), rank_num = VALUES(rank_num), eps = VALUES(eps), collection_type = VALUES(collection_type), collection_type_name = VALUES(collection_type_name), user_rate = VALUES(user_rate), user_comment = VALUES(user_comment), air_date = VALUES(air_date), tags = VALUES(tags), short_summary = VALUES(short_summary), collection_updated_at = VALUES(collection_updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT subject_type_name AS name, subject_type AS typeId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bangumi_collection GROUP BY subject_type, subject_type_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT collection_type_name AS name, collection_type AS typeId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bangumi_collection GROUP BY collection_type, collection_type_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(score), 0.0) FROM bangumi_collection WHERE score > 0
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(user_rate), 0.0) FROM bangumi_collection WHERE user_rate > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bangumi_collection WHERE user_comment IS NOT NULL AND user_comment != ''
